description: rhize-context-manager — context-window monitor + stack-aware session disclosure. The monitor replaces ECC's `pre:edit-write:suggest-compact`, which sized the window by sniffing the model id for a `[1m]` marker and so reported 97% usage on a 1M-window Opus 5 session that was really at 20%. This hook resolves the window from a verified known-model table first. Scoped to Edit|Write for parity with the hook it replaces, keeping the node spawn off every Read/Bash call. Disable ECC's version (ECC_DISABLED_HOOKS=pre:edit-write:suggest-compact) or the two will both fire. session-disclosure.js (SessionStart) replaces the four per-plugin SessionStart banners (seo-aeo-geo, obsidian-second-brain, project-launcher, rhize-devflow) retired 2026-08-09 in Phase 3 of the skill-map plan — see docs/skill-map.md. remediation-suggester.js (PostToolUse, matcher Bash) and next-step-suggester.js (PostToolUse, matcher Skill) are the relationships-v2 consumers added 2026-08-09 (design doc section 7) — both auto-wired here like session-disclosure.js, not opt-in via setup/manifest.json. This directory also bundles two opt-in refinement-pipeline hooks, neither wired below — moved from rhize-devflow, see CHANGELOG 2026-08-09; enable via README.md's Hooks section.
